description: Semantic versioning toolkit with npm (node-semver) semantics: validate and parse a version, compare two versions, test a range (^, ~, x-ranges, hyphen ranges, || unions, prerelease rules) and show its comparator form, sort a list and pick the max/min version satisfying a range, and bump (major, minor, patch, pre*, prerelease with an identifier). Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/semver

includePrerelease.description: Let prerelease versions satisfy ranges without a matching prerelease tuple

preid.description: Prerelease identifier for pre* bumps (e.g. beta, rc)

version.description: A version to parse / test / bump

versions.description: Versions to sort / filter by range

name: semver
title: Semver
